subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & budget range for PayBridge integration
messages:
From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@paybridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Menon <aisha@paybridge.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & token-volume estimate

Hi Dylan - thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can move to procurement: 

- Use case: conversational payments assistant (customer support & payment flows) tied to transaction lookups.
- Expected volume: initial pilot ~50M tokens/month (prompt + response); if pilot succeeds, scale to 200-300M tokens/month within 6-9 months.
- Target monthly budget (internal band): $10k - $30k. Procurement has thresholds that determine approval path (see below).

Questions:
1) Can you validate the $/1M-token unit economics for the model(s) we discussed (redwood-compact and redwood-standard)? We want a target of <= $150 / 1M tokens for the pilot to be viable.
2) What discounts or reserved-commit pricing is available at 50M vs 250M tokens/month?
3) Procurement note: anything above $25k/month requires enterprise procurement review and a PO, smaller spends can be on card or a simplified contract. Can you confirm what paperwork/triggers you expect?

I've attached our rough MAP worksheet (PayBridge-MAP-20260320.xlsx) with projected volumes.

Thanks - happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Chris
Chris Lang
Head of Product, PayBridge
chris.lang@paybridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachment: PayBridge-MAP-20260320.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris.lang@paybridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & token-volume estimate

Hi Chris - great to meet you and thanks for the clear MAP. Below is a short validation and two pricing bands we typically use for this profile. I also attached a one-page pricing estimate for the pilot.

Pilot assumptions (based on our call and your MAP):
- Pilot window: 1-3 months, ~50M tokens/month (prompt+response).
- Production ramp: 200-300M tokens/month by month 6-9.
- Peak concurrency: please confirm, but assumed < 40 concurrent requests for sizing.

Pricing (unit: $ per 1M tokens):
- Redwood-Standard (hosted): $140 / 1M tokens (pay-as-you-go).
- Redwood-Compact (smaller footprint / quantized): $95 / 1M tokens.
- Redwood-Optimize (optimization + prefix caching): estimated 20-30% saving on average (post-optimization effective unit ~$67-76 / 1M).

Reserved / committed discounts (examples):
- 6-month commit at 200M/month: additional 20% discount off hosted list.
- 12-month commit at 250M/month: up to 40% discount (enterprise pricing / SLA required).

Procurement triggers & paperwork:
- <$25k/month: standard MSA + SOW, can be invoiced; many customers use a company card or a short PO.
- >=$25k/month: procurement requires PO + SOW + finance onboarding (invoice terms), and legal review if adding custom clauses.
- We can provide SOC2 + dataflow docs and our security questionnaire (PDF) upon request.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send a short one-page pricing estimate (attached).
2) If $95-140 / 1M aligns with your target, we can prepare a pilot SOW and a procurement checklist for your team.
3) If you want tighter unit economics for scale, we can model a committed discount scenario and show the effective $/1M at 200-300M.

Are you available Mon/Tue next week for a 30-min procurement + finance alignment call?

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood-pricing-estimate-20260320.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: quick internal: PayBridge thresholds

Dylan - quick note on the options you sent. Agreed to lead with the Compact pricing for pilot since their target is <= $150 / 1M. A couple of internal asks: 

- Offer a 15% pilot discount (one-time) if they commit in writing to a 3-month pilot at 50M/mo. That brings Compact to ~ $80 / 1M during the pilot.
- For procurement: if they expect to stay under $25k/month, keep the standard MSA + SOW. If they signal >$25k/mo, escalate to enterprise pricing and involve Solutions Engineering for guaranteed latency targets.
- Please include SOC2 attestation and a short data-handling summary in the packet you send them.

I'll defer to Aditya on legal language for the SOW template.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@paybridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Menon <aisha@paybridge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & token-volume estimate

Thanks Dylan - and thanks Marissa. That pricing context is super helpful. A few clarifications from procurement and product: 

- Token definition: we count prompt+response combined; the MAP sheet uses that convention, so your numbers line up.
- Budget band: we can confirm pilot $10k-15k/mo (firm), production target $20k-30k/mo. So pilot is within the <$25k threshold but production may cross it.

Two procurement questions: 
1) For the pilot band (<= $15k/mo), can we accept a short SOW + MSA and pay by card or monthly invoice? That is the preference.
2) If we decide to scale (>= $25k/mo), we will need a PO and standard 30/60 invoice terms. In that scenario, would Redwood require an enterprise onboarding checklist / finance contact?

If you can send a short SOW and the one-page pilot pricing (with the 15% pilot discount noted), we can route to procurement and legal. Can you also include SOC2 and a contact for finance?

Appreciate the quick turnaround - if easier, we can jump on a 20-min call Mon morning.

Chris

Attachment: PayBridge-MAP-20260320.xlsx (referenced)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris.lang@paybridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & token-volume estimate

Chris - thanks for the clarity. Finalizing the numbers and next steps below so procurement has what it needs.

Finalized unit economics (post-internal approval):
- Pilot (50M/mo) - Redwood-Compact: list $95 / 1M -> pilot discount 15% -> effective $80.75 / 1M.
  - 50M tokens -> ~ $4,038 / month (pilot estimate).
- Production-scale (200-300M/mo) - committed pricing examples (requires 6-12 month commit):
  - 6-month commit at 200M/mo: effective ~$76 / 1M (after 20% commit discount + optimization opportunities).
  - 12-month commit at 250M/mo: effective ~$48-57 / 1M (after up to 40% enterprise discount + Optimize).

Procurement workflow:
- Pilot (<= $15k/mo): standard MSA + short SOW is sufficient; we can invoice monthly or accept card. We will include SOC2 report and a one-page data-handling summary.
- Scale (>= $25k/mo): PO required, standard invoice terms (Net30/Net60 as agreed), and enterprise onboarding (finance contact + solutions engineering for latency SLA).

Attachments sent: Redwood-pricing-estimate-20260320.pdf (one-pager with the pilot numbers) and SOW-template-2026.docx. Also linking the HubSpot deal and a DocuSign route in case procurement prefers e-signature.

Next steps:
1) I'll upload the one-pager + SOW to your procurement channel and share SOC2.
2) If pilot pricing looks good, please sign the SOW (DocuSign link included) and we'll kick off onboarding.
3) If you want committed pricing modeled, Aditya and I can prepare a 200-300M token commit scenario with exact monthly run-rate and SLA add-ons.

Are you available Mon 2026-03-23 at 10:00am PT for a 20-min procurement alignment?

Thanks - looking forward.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood-pricing-estimate-20260320.pdf, SOW-template-2026.docx
